# Midday alert, Thu 2026-11-12 (~12:30 PM ET)

**NVDA CEO exit confirmed.** Jensen Huang resigned; CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO. NVDA ~−4% to −5% midday, CRWV ~−4%, INTC/MU lower; AMD and AVGO ~+7% ([Radiocor/Borsa Italiana](https://www.borsaitaliana.it/borsa/notizie/radiocor/finance/dettaglio/us-midday-shares-higher-despite-nvidia-leadership-change-nRC_12112026_1724_657925494.html?lang=en); [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-thursday-november-12-sp-500-nasdaq-dow-nvidia-slides-jensen-huang-resigns-invest-165632931.html)). **NBIS** reversed to ~−15% on 2026 revenue guide at low end of estimates. Indexes recovered to green (S&P +0.4% at 11:22 AM ET). Macro: claims 200K vs 195K est.; existing home sales −5.5% to 16-yr low; Treasuries sold off after Trump said no Iran deal needed ([Dow Jones/Morningstar](https://www.morningstar.com/news/dow-jones/2026111211056/dow-jones-top-markets-headlines-at-11-am-et-us-stocks-fall-as-nvidia-tumbles-after-ceo-exit-home)).

**Desk:** AI-hardware/data-center avoid through 11/18 stands (incl. AMD/AVGO despite pop; sector-shock bounce lesson). No new longs in the group. signals.json reasons updated; no new tickers.
